name: Agent Red Teaming Benchmark
intro: Agent Red Teaming（ART）Benchmark 从 Gray Swan 公开挑战赛的 180 万次攻击提交中，经更严格的 LLM 评审与按行为-模型组合采样，筛选出覆盖 44 个部署场景的 4,700 条高质量提示注入，用于评估 Agent 的策略违规风险与攻击迁移性。
org: Gray Swan AI, UK AI Security Institute
build_method: 公开红队挑战赛采集, 严格LLM评审筛选, 分层采样
metric: 行为级攻击成功率 ASR@k（k=1/10/100）, 攻击迁移率
eval_feature: 直接与间接提示注入, 多查询预算, 跨模型迁移与通用性分析
scale: 4,700条精选攻击, 44个目标行为（源自180万次提交与6万+成功违规）
build_method_en: Public red-team challenge collection, stricter LLM-judge filtering, stratified sampling
eval_feature_en: Direct and indirect prompt injection, multi-query budgets, cross-model transfer and universality analysis
intro_en: The Agent Red Teaming (ART) Benchmark filters 1.8 million submissions from Gray Swan's public challenge with a stricter LLM judge, then samples by behavior-model pair to produce 4,700 high-quality prompt injections across 44 deployment settings for evaluating policy violations and attack transferability.
scale_en: 4,700 selected attacks across 44 target behaviors (from 1.8M submissions and 60K+ successful violations)
metric_en: Behavior attack success rate ASR@k (k=1/10/100), attack transfer rate
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Deploy 22 frontier AI agents across 44 realistic deployment scenarios for public competition"] --> B["Collect 1.8 million prompt-injection attacks submitted by competition participants"]
    B["Collect 1.8 million prompt-injection attacks submitted by competition participants"] --> C["Identify over 60,000 successful attacks eliciting policy violations like unauthorized access and financial misconduct"]
    C["Identify over 60,000 successful attacks eliciting policy violations like unauthorized access and financial misconduct"] --> D["Curate high-impact attacks from competition results to construct ART benchmark"]
    D["Curate high-impact attacks from competition results to construct ART benchmark"] --> E["Evaluate 19 state-of-the-art models using the curated benchmark"]
    E["Evaluate 19 state-of-the-art models using the curated benchmark"] --> F["Measure policy violations within 10-100 queries and assess attack transferability across models"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.20526 Sections 2-3: 44 manually curated agent/tool/adversarial-goal/success-criteria scenarios across four policy-violation categories; the March 8-April 6, 2025 four-wave Gray Swan challenge over 22 anonymized frontier agents; 1.8M direct and indirect prompt-injection submissions; automated success judging with a human appeal path and 60K+ successful violations; stricter LLM-judge filtering followed by up to five attacks per behavior-model pair; the final 4,700-attack ART subset; evaluation of 19 challenge and unseen models at k=1/10/100; behavior ASR, cross-model transfer, and universal attack-cluster analysis.
